The fix is commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc`, "(fix) O3-5958: Default the queue location to the one selected in Service Queues (#2731)" by Mutagubya Jonathan. The commit changes the queue-fields form to read the selected queue location from the Service Queues store, falling back to the session location. Its diff touches only `queue-fields.component.tsx`:

- Line 68 now also destructures `selectedQueueLocationUuid` from the store.
- Line 81 seeds the form's `queueLocation` default with `selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`. Before, it was `sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`, so a non-queue-tagged login location left the field blank.

The ancestor resolution that the dashboard uses is in the header title component. It walks the session location's ancestry, picks the nearest queue-tagged location, and writes it to the store (lines 35–68). The store setters are in `store.ts` (lines 45–48). The test file covers the ancestor fallback (lines 71–79).

One thing I did not verify: the commit message says "asynchronously", but the diff contains no async change. `useForm` reads its defaults only at mount. If the header resolves the ancestor after the form mounts, the field could still be blank. I did not check the ordering.

Patient management is the only repository touched by this change, so no other repository's commit is involved.

All three read the\nnew config, so the count cannot disagree with the rows beneath it.\n\n- Count the waiting list via queue-entry-metrics instead of paging through\n  every entry. useQueueEntriesMetrics now reports isLoading and error so the\n  tab label shows no momentary \"(0)\" before the request settles.\n- Drop useServiceMetricsCount: it hardcoded status=Waiting as a concept name\n  and has no remaining callers.\n- Send forDate as an ISO 8601 string. The appointments module's DateUtil does\n  not parse a ZZ numeric offset.
